manifest_excerpt:
One single-model interactive run, 21-22 November 2026, producing a 13-file corpus. It finds that the headline theorem proves Mathlib's standard RiemannHypothesis statement, which a comparator and two independent cross-checks support. The 'GRH' covers Dirichlet L-functions only. Kernel replays of the full export were still running at the last status check. The corpus also maps about 40 perspectives, documents the competing all-human Masullo claim, and logs claims C1-C15 with ten documented mutations across outlets.

Caveat: single model, ungraded, with a conflict of interest, since Claude assembled a corpus about a Claude-produced result. No Lean was executed in this run.
